basis: Official harvested metadata copy, not alternative dataset or circumvention of restricted source. Public SDC record confirms DOI, source identity and public release; Data.gov links original FGDC XML. ScienceBase 403 retained.
allowed: original XML metadata only, identity, citations, temporal and spatial registry definitions, field names and definitions, entity filenames if declared; do not follow file links or fetch payloads; aggregate published context already exposed; no individual fish rows.
qualification: Even valid original metadata is not a file manifest or proof of bytes; keep response sealed unless exact file identity and split independently confirmed. If XML inaccessible, retain blocker. No other candidate searches, no retries of ScienceBase denied endpoint.
scope: No biological score, no new EOG-WF endpoint, frozen 3/31/3.
